title_en: VILLA FOR SALE – COLLINA VERDE, TEG (OCCASION)
description_en: Luxury villa for sale in the Collina Verde residence, with a total construction area of ​​480 m² and a plot of 715 m². The villa is organized on 3 floors: Floor -1 (160 m²): technical facilities, 2 toilets, laundry, food store, sauna room, wine cellar, private room and 2 work rooms. Floor 0 (160 m²): large living room, kitchen, toilet, wardrobe and exit to the yard. 1st floor (160 m²): double bedroom with toilet & wardrobe, 2 bedrooms and 1 toilet. Quality workmanship and investment made in detail by the owner. For information and a visit to the property, contact!
